deltas.title_id: Surat Edaran Direktur Jenderal Pajak Nomor SE-8/PJ/2026
deltas.title_en: Directorate General of Taxes Circular Letter No. SE-8/PJ/2026
deltas.impact_note: DJP introduces automated taxpayer supervision via its internal information system, new criteria determining which taxpayers fall under 'penelitian komprehensif' (comprehensive examination), CSQA/PSQA quality-assurance frameworks for audit staff, and coordinated simultaneous supervision of taxpayer groups (relevant to PT PMA group structures) — clients should be briefed on the new audit-trigger criteria even though no fee or filing deadline changes.
deltas.summary: New DJP circular overhauls tax supervision/audit methodology: automated system-driven monitoring, revised comprehensive-examination criteria, quality-assurance certification (CSQA/PSQA) for supervising officers, and coordinated group-taxpayer oversight.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: SE-8/PJ/2026 — Kantor Pajak Terapkan Pengawasan Otomatis lewat Sistem Informasi DJP; Jamin Mutu Pengawasan Pajak, DJP Perkenalkan CSQA dan PSQA; Ada SE Baru, Ini Kriteria WP yang Tercakup Penelitian Komprehensif; SE Baru Mungkinkan Pengawasan WP Grup secara Simultan & Terkoordinasi
